entries.title: Analytics view authorization
entries.criterion: Every browser/Data-API reporting view uses security-invoker semantics or an equivalent trusted authorization boundary; aggregate/report access cannot exceed the caller's permitted underlying RLS scope.

entries.title: No unbounded lists
entries.criterion: All Leads/Clients/Quotes/Tasks/Activities list paths are paginated or otherwise bounded.

entries.title: Realtime RLS
entries.criterion: Unauthorized user cannot receive protected realtime row data.

entries.title: Cross-user update
entries.criterion: A permitted change by User B updates a subscribed User A view without polling on selected realtime screens.

entries.title: No polling regression
entries.criterion: No high-frequency interval polling exists for realtime-covered state.

entries.title: Conflict UX
entries.criterion: Stale Lead/Quote save presents a clear conflict and does not overwrite silently.

entries.title: Browser storage audit
entries.criterion: No bulk CRM PII is intentionally persisted to localStorage/IndexedDB.

entries.title: Responsive smoke
entries.criterion: Critical workflows remain usable at agreed mobile/tablet/desktop widths.

entries.title: Accessibility smoke
entries.criterion: Critical workflows are keyboard-operable and major automated accessibility issues are absent.

entries.title: Performance budget
entries.criterion: Critical list/detail/save interactions meet the agreed budget on representative data and network conditions.

proof.assertion: assert(executionTime < 250, `${label} exceeded 250 ms: ${executionTime} ms`);

entries.title: Project quality gate
entries.criterion: All prior functional/security tests remain green.

proof.assertion: assert(start >= 0, `No execution plan returned for ${query}`);

entries.title: Realtime dependency restraint
entries.criterion: Realtime is enabled only for explicitly documented features, does not become durable truth, and no global realtime layer is introduced by default.

entries.title: Anonymous access audit
entries.criterion: Anonymous access to protected business rows/documents is denied.

entries.title: Role matrix audit
entries.criterion: Owner/Admin/Sales/Viewer permissions match the frozen matrix across all exposed resources/actions.

entries.title: Secret scan
entries.criterion: No trusted secret appears in browser bundle, repository history in scope, or public config.

entries.title: Webhook auth failure
entries.criterion: Invalid/missing Bricks or provider webhook authentication is rejected safely.

proof.assertion: assert(sendpulseDenied.status === 401, 'SendPulse webhook accepted an unauthenticated request');

entries.title: XSS/input smoke
entries.criterion: Representative untrusted text is escaped/sanitized according to rendering context.

entries.title: Private storage
entries.criterion: Anonymous quote-document access is denied.

proof.assertion: assert(!anonymousObject.ok, 'Private quote document was publicly readable');

entries.title: Recovery-set creation
entries.criterion: Database, required Storage artifacts/mapping, schema/config evidence and Auth reconstruction inputs/procedure are captured according to the encrypted recovery contract.

entries.title: Restore drill
entries.criterion: Database + representative private documents restore into a disposable environment; user/Auth reconstruction procedure works; critical records/relationships/artifact hashes can be read and used.

entries.title: Migration reset
entries.criterion: Fresh database migrates/seed successfully from zero.

entries.title: Upgrade rehearsal
entries.criterion: Representative prior schema can migrate forward without unintended data loss.

entries.title: Duplicate external events
entries.criterion: Bricks/SendPulse retries remain idempotent after hardening.

entries.title: Won E2E
entries.criterion: Login → Bricks → Lead → Quote → Send → Reminder → Won → Client passes.

entries.title: Lost E2E
entries.criterion: Lead → Lost → required reason → task cleanup/activity passes.

entries.title: Production build
entries.criterion: Full check/test/build/db/diff gate passes from clean checkout.

entries.title: Launch blocker review
entries.criterion: No unresolved Critical/High security, recovery, data-integrity, or migration blocker remains.

entries.title: Activity immutability regression
entries.criterion: Ordinary application roles still cannot UPDATE/DELETE Activity after complete schema/policy evolution.

entries.title: Privileged audit evidence
entries.criterion: Representative role/config/reopen/recovery privileged actions create durable actor/time/action audit evidence.

entries.title: MFA/AAL2 readiness gate
entries.criterion: Pilot/production checklist blocks Owner/Admin readiness until MFA enrollment policy exists **and** representative privileged actions are proven to deny AAL1 and allow authorized AAL2 sessions.

proof.assertion: assert(aal2.data?.currentLevel === 'aal2', 'verified TOTP session did not reach AAL2');

entries.title: Privacy operations
entries.criterion: Retention, data-subject request, incident escalation, operator/responsible-party and cross-border review procedures are executable and ownership is named.

entries.title: Backup ageing/privacy
entries.criterion: Procedure explains and tests how deletions/anonymisations propagate to live data and age out of retained backup sets without ordinary history mutation.

entries.title: Dependency security baseline
entries.criterion: Direct dependency inventory matches the approved baseline, exact pins/lockfile are intact, relevant known advisories are reviewed, and any required security update passes the governed regression process.

entries.title: Auth reconstruction fidelity
entries.criterion: Disposable recovery proves the documented identity/profile/role/status reconstruction path, preserves or deterministically remaps identity references as documented, restores suspension semantics and Storage mapping, and explicitly proves password/MFA reset or re-enrollment steps where credentials/factors are not portably restored.

entries.title: Fresh local Supabase provisioning
entries.criterion: A fresh local/disposable Supabase instance reaches the current schema and baseline settings from zero with no undocumented SQL/manual edits.

entries.title: Local production build
entries.criterion: The Cloudflare Workers-compatible production build/artifact completes locally using the documented command and environment contract without publication.

	);

entries.title: Brand-only configuration
entries.criterion: Changing approved brand configuration updates client identity without editing reusable component source.

entries.title: Locale/quote configuration
entries.criterion: Currency, locale, tax labels/defaults, quote prefix, validity, and approved terms/defaults change through configuration.

entries.title: Integration configuration contract
entries.criterion: Bricks and SendPulse client-specific identifiers/secrets can be supplied through the documented trusted configuration boundaries without core-domain edits or secret leakage.

entries.title: No client fork
entries.criterion: A fresh client dry run requires no permanent client-specific source branch or duplicated application code.

entries.title: Secret isolation
entries.criterion: Client secrets remain outside source control and browser bundles.

entries.title: Offboarding dry run
entries.criterion: Documentation proves a client instance can be exported/transferred independently without entangling another client.

proof.assertion: assert(documentation.includes(phrase), `Client deployment documentation is missing: ${phrase}`);

entries.title: Upgrade rehearsal
entries.criterion: A representative prior local instance upgrades to current code/migrations without losing configuration or data.

entries.title: Fresh-template quality gate
entries.criterion: The freshly provisioned local template passes the same format/check/test/build/database/diff gates as the baseline.

entries.title: External-step boundary
entries.criterion: All real remote deployment, DNS, sender-domain authentication, and pilot actions are explicitly identified as post-build/external steps rather than falsely marked locally complete.

entries.title: Pinned provisioning toolchain
entries.criterion: Fresh-client procedure identifies and successfully uses the pinned/constrained toolchain rather than `latest`.

entries.title: Client governance config
entries.criterion: Template explicitly captures timezone/currency, privacy/recovery ownership, MFA prerequisite and integration ownership without client-specific code forks.

entries.title: Fresh local client bootstrap
entries.criterion: A disposable client instance is created from zero using only documented configuration/migrations/seed and reaches a usable authenticated CRM state.

entries.criterion: Canonical Bricks-compatible local intake → Lead → Quote → communication-contract success → follow-up → Won → Client completes without direct DB edits.
